messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Multiple layered plots
parts:
Hi Teragene,

The easiest way is to combine the two datasets together:

set1$set <- 1
set2$set <- 2
all <- rbind(set1, set2)

allm <- melt(all, id = "set")

ggplot(..., data = all) + facet_grid(set ~ variable)

Regards,

Hadley
